What if time stopped for five seconds… for everyone except you?
Cars, people and birds would freeze in place. Sounds fun, right?
But light would freeze too. No light would reach your eyes, so everything would go completely dark.
Sound needs moving air, so there would be total silence.
And the air itself would be frozen. Every molecule stuck in place, like an invisible wall. You couldn't even take a breath.
You'd be trapped in the dark, unable to move or breathe.
Then time starts again… and nobody would ever know anything happened.
Would you still want to stop time? Tell me in the comments.
